SELECT c.* FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.cell ORDER BY a.id) AS row_num FROM b_didi_v5_colliding_data a WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.api_code = #{apiCode} AND a.local_id = #{localId} AND a.push_status = 0 AND date(a.colliding_time) = date(#{collidingDate}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM b_didi_v5_colliding_data_rob rob WHERE rob.cell = a.cell AND rob.api_code = a.api_code AND rob.package_id = a.local_id)) AS c WHERE c.row_num = 1 AND c.id > #{minId} ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{pageSize}

SELECT c.* FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.cell ORDER BY a.id ASC) AS row_num FROM b_didi_v5_colliding_data a WHERE a.api_code = #{apiCode} AND a.push_status = 0 AND DATE (a.colliding_time) >= DATE(#{collidingTime}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM b_didi_v5_colliding_data_rob rob WHERE rob.cell = a.cell AND rob.api_code = a.api_code AND rob.package_id = a.local_id )) AS c WHERE c.row_num = 1 AND c.id > #{minId} ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT #{pageSize}
